bind.description: Network interface to bind to, either as host:port (e.g., '0.0.0.0:8000') or a Unix socket path (e.g., '/run/gunicorn.sock').

workers.description: Number of worker processes. Typically 2–4 × number of CPU cores.

timeout.description: Seconds before worker is killed and restarted if no response.

accesslog.description: Path to access log file, or '-' to log to stdout.

errorlog.description: Path to error log file, or '-' to log to stderr.

loglevel.description: Logging level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical.

threads.description: Number of threads per worker (used only with 'gthread' or 'sync' workers).

max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests a worker handles before graceful restart (0 = disabled).

graceful_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for workers to finish in-flight requests before force-kill.

pidfile.description: Path to write PID file (optional; leave blank to disable).

user.description: Unix username to drop privileges to after binding (requires root; optional).

group.description: Unix group to drop privileges to after binding (requires root; optional).

env.description: List of environment variables to set for worker processes (as key-value pairs).

value.description: Boolean value (true/false) or string/number if applicable

extra_args.description: Additional command-line style arguments as key-value pairs (e.g., {'--preload': true}).

keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file

ssl.description: SSL/TLS configuration for HTTPS. Provide certfile and keyfile at minimum.

backlog.description: Maximum number of queued connections (socket backlog).

keepalive.description: Seconds to keep idle connections open (0 = disabled).

proc_name.description: Process name prefix shown in process lists (e.g., 'myapp:gunicorn').

pre_load.description: Optional Python code for a pre_load() hook (called before app load, e.g., 'pass' or 'import mymodule').
